We have template details. The retro_smarts_template shows a disconnection: product (target) is left side? Actually retro_smarts_template: '[C:8]-[C@@H;D3;+0:9]...>>[C:1]-[C;H0;D3;+0:2](=[O;H0;D1;+0:3])-[C:4]... . So retrosynthetic direction: product (target) is left side? Wait typical retro template: product -> precursors. The retro_smarts_template shows left side (product) as [C:8]-[C@@H... etc] which matches our target? Our target has a cyclobutane? Let's examine target SMILES: [CH2]=[C]([c]1... ) [C@@H]1[CH2][CH2][CH2][C@@]1([OH])[C]([F])([F])[F]. This seems like a bicyclic? The template left side includes [C:8]-[C@@H... etc] which is a bond between C8 and C9? The product side includes a carbonyl (C=O) and a vinyl group with aromatic? The right side (precursors) are two fragments: a carbonyl fragment and a vinyl aromatic fragment.

Thus applying this template to target should give two precursors: a carbonyl fragment (maybe a fluorinated carbonyl) and a vinyl aromatic fragment.

We need to apply template to target to get precursors. Use apply_template.
